name: Waldorf Astoria Maldives Ithaafushi
positioning: Villa resort on Ithaafushi Island in the South Male Atoll, with beach, reef and overwater pool villas spread across three islands
best_for: Food-focused travelers who want varied dining, from treetop bamboo nests to a limestone wine cellar
Families wanting a kids club and spa sessions for children aged 7 to 15
Couples planning a wedding on the beach or in an overwater pavilion

facts.text: The resort is on Ithaafushi Island in the South Male Atoll.
The beach, reef and overwater villas span three islands.
Each villa is set in a private enclave with a pool and ocean views.
Li Long serves Peking duck roasted in what the hotel calls the Maldives' first classic wood-fired oven.
Terra's pairings are curated by what the hotel calls the Maldives' first resident Krug Ambassador.
Amber is the resort's signature overwater Champagne bar.
Zuma serves contemporary Japanese dining, with robata and sushi, in an overwater setting.
The spa offers what the hotel calls the Maldives' first Wellness Concierge service.
Guests get a complimentary 30-minute session with the on-site tennis pro.
Water sports include parasailing and the Seabob underwater scooter.
Weddings can be held on the beach or in an overwater Wedding Pavilion.
Conde Nast Traveler notes the spa's roster of visiting practitioners, such as Chinese acupuncturists and tarot card readers.

highlights.text: At Terra, guests dine in one of seven private bamboo nests suspended high above the island.
The Rock is a subterranean cellar of Jordanian limestone, centered on a 200-year-old Jarrah wood table, that hosts wine dinners for 12 guests.
The spa has what the hotel calls the Maldives' first Aqua Wellness Centre, with a custom hydrotherapy pool, ice fountain, steam room and sauna.
Ithaafushi, the private island, features a three-bedroom beach villa, a two-bedroom overwater villa, a four-bedroom residence, five pools and a private entertainment clubhouse.
Guests can adopt a coral frame to support the resort's coral nursery and Ocean Conservation Program.

considerations.text: The villas are spread across three islands rather than one.
Wine dinners at The Rock are for 12 guests.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the resort's exclusive positioning.
